Hi Anna / Michael —

Thanks again for taking the time today. Quick recap from our discovery and proposed next steps so we’re all aligned: 

1) Success criteria (what you said you care about):
   - ~90% accuracy on intent classification for English customer support tickets (measured vs. your labeled 5k sample)
   - Latency under 600ms p50 for 512-token responses in your US region with 8 concurrent agents
   - Support for bilingual responses (EN/ES) for top support flows

2) POC plan & timeline:
   - Week 1 (Jun 15–19): Access & dataset handoff, confirm eval scripts
   - Week 2 (Jun 22–26): Model selection, baseline runs, and initial tuning
   - Week 3 (Jun 29–Jul 3): User-simulated load tests and accuracy evals
   - Week 4 (Jul 6–10): Final report, handoff, and recommended production config

3) Proposed models for trial:
   - Primary: Llama-2-Chat-13B (quantized 40) — strong balance of accuracy and latency for classification + generation
   - Fallback: Mistral-Instruct-7B (faster low-cost option) if we need lower-latency/throughput bursts
   - Multilingual handling: route Spanish requests to the same primary model but include targeted instruction prompts and small ES fine-tune if needed

4) Ownership & next steps:
   - Redwood: provide hosted POC instance, baseline runs, help with eval scripts (Ben, Marissa)
   - IntegriTech: provide labeled sample set (5k), API access to staging ticket stream, and success-criteria sign-off (Anna, Michael)
   - Kickoff call: proposed Mon Jun 15 10:00am PT — I sent a Calendly link below.

Attachments: Redwood POC evaluation plan (PDF) and a suggested success-criteria spreadsheet.

If that all looks right, can you confirm the success criteria and the dataset handoff timeline? I’ll lock in the kickoff slot.

Thanks,
Ben

Hi Ben —

Thanks for the clear recap — this matches what we discussed. A few clarifications from our side: 

- Success criteria: the 90% accuracy target is for intent classification on the 5k labeled set; for generated replies we’re comfortable with a human eval threshold of >=4/5 on helpfulness for the top 10 intents.
- Spanish handling: we have ~800 labeled ES examples. If initial runs show a drop of >8% relative to EN, we’ll consider a small ES fine-tune or retrieval augmentation.
- Latency target: 600ms p50 is fine for the POC, but for production we’d want p95 < 1.2s — will need to discuss Dedicated/reserved capacity options later.

We’ll share the labeled sample and a staging API key by EOD Friday (Jun 12). Kickoff on Mon Jun 15 10:00am PT works.

One ask: can you include one fallback model optimized for cost (e.g., Mistral family) and a plan for automatic routing if the primary model hits capacity?

Thanks — looking forward to the test.
Anna
Head of Product, IntegriTech
